name: koalafix-auto
description: One memory for every AI tool on your team. In Claude chat and Cowork: KoalaFix's tools and skill. In Claude Code its hooks make it automatic: the team brief at session start, recall on each prompt, a note before the first edit of a file a teammate is on, one browser sign-in. The hooks send each prompt (keys and tokens removed, never logged) and the file paths it or an edit names to your KoalaFix server; teammates see your project, branch and the prompt's paths. Needs Node.js 22+.
